title: Sub-bottom profiling shows the layers under the object

tellings.quote: sub-bottom profiling have we done. Mhm.

plain: A Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg says his team found a strange object on the floor of the Baltic Sea, between Sweden and Finland. Speaking with a podcast host, Jesse Michels, in 2025, he says they have also done sub-bottom profiling, a sonar method that looks at the layers of mud and rock beneath the seabed, to see what lies under the object. If the scans show what he suggests, it would help say whether the object is a natural formation or something else.
